title: Barbu: Learn Card Games
shortDescription: Learn classic card games, practise your skills, then play with friends.
fullDescription:
Bring a new game to the table.

Barbu helps you learn classic card games through short interactive lessons and guided play. Practise against computer opponents, then take what you have learned to a real table with friends, family or your local card club.

LEARN BY PLAYING
Make card decisions, get feedback and build your understanding one lesson at a time. Follow a learning path, revisit a skill or check the rules when you need them.

PRACTISE AT YOUR OWN PACE
Play full hands and matches against computer opponents. Guided hands offer explanations as you play, and saved games let you return to an unfinished session.

EXPLORE CLASSIC CARD GAMES
- Hearts: passing, penalty cards and shooting the moon.
- Gin Rummy: drawing, discarding, melds, deadwood, knocking and gin.
- Spades: partnership bids, nil and bags.
- Whist: trumps and partnership trick-taking.
- Bridge: bidding, contracts, declarer and dummy play.
- Barbu: a seven-contract training session with different challenges, including Domino.

GET READY TO PLAY TOGETHER
Build confidence before joining an in-person game. Share Barbu with a friend, or use Get out and play to open a Google Maps search for nearby card clubs. Search results are provided by Google Maps, not a verified Barbu club directory.

Barbu is a single-player learning and practice game. It does not offer online multiplayer, club membership or tournament booking. Local tables may use different rules and conventions; check with your group before playing.
